info.title: API.SH: ThriftBooks
info.description: The ThriftBooks API from API.SH: public ThriftBooks data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One edition on ThriftBooks by ISBN (or edition id): title, ISBN-10/13, UPC, format, publisher, release date, language, pages, weight and dimensions, list price, low/high price, cheapest new and used copy, every copy for sale (condition, price, quantity, ex-library, missing jacket or CD), sales ranks, age and grade range, synopsis, cover, the work id, and professional reviews (Library Journal, Publishers Weekly...).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thriftbooks-edition

parameters.name: isbn
parameters.description: ISBN-10, ISBN-13 or UPC. Either isbn or id is required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Edition id (`edition.id` from search, `items[].id` from editions).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every edition of a ThriftBooks work: edition id, ISBN-10/13, UPC, format, publisher, release date, language, pages, weight, large print, list price, description, cover, authors, people watching, copies received in the last six months, and the copies for sale (condition, price, quantity, ex-library, missing jacket or CD). Filter by format, condition, in stock, large print or foreign language; 5 sort orders. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thriftbooks-editions

parameters.name: foreign_language

get.description:
Books, audiobooks and movies on ThriftBooks with every filter of its browse page: in stock, first editions, signed, collectibles, new releases, deals, large print, condition, language, format, genre, product type, price range and excluded words, in 7 sort orders. Each result is a work with its best edition (ISBN, format, publisher, release date, language, list price, cover), the cheapest copy you can buy now (price, condition, ex-library, missing jacket or CD), the price range, available copies, number of editions, customer rating and review count, copies sold in the last six months, wishlist count, series, authors and the cheapest collectible copy. `facets` gives the counts per genre, format, condition, language and age range (send a genre's `id` back as `genre_id`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thriftbooks-search

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: Only works with copies for sale (default true; false includes out-of-stock titles).

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Comma list of: new, like_new, very_good, good, acceptable.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Comma list of formats: paperback, hardcover, mass_market_paperback, library_binding, board_book, spiral_bound, audio_cd, audio_cassette, cd, vinyl, dvd, blu_ray, 4k_ultra_hd, vhs, comic, perfect_paperback.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Comma list of languages: english, spanish, french, german, italian, portuguese, russian, chinese, japanese, korean, dutch, greek, polish, swedish, turkish, latin, arabic, hebrew.

parameters.name: genre_id
parameters.description: Comma list of genre ids from `facets.genre`.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Comma list of words to leave out.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thriftbooks-work

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
